mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact circle-weight second/fourth moments, zero-weight bound, global and small-degree contraction bounds, the spherical eigenvalue and its explicit nonmaximality example.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q, exact Fraction arithmetic and integer Weyl dimensions.
mathematics.conventions: Balanced highest weights of U(m); circle diag(exp(it),1,...,1); phi(j)=1/binomial(m+abs(j),abs(j)).
inputs: Every balanced decreasing integer weight with m=2..6, coordinates in -5..5 and positive degree at most 6.
non_claims: No certification of arbitrary weights by finite enumeration.
No transfer of Haar norm estimates to an unknown ensemble.
